recommendations.text: Extend era resolution below line granularity. Three P2 rows (070#6[0], 070#6[1], and by the same trap the whole line-115 sentence) would have been mis-booked as DOC-DEFECT-AT-ERA on `git blame` alone; `git log -S <clause>` reversed the verdict by 30 hours. Prose lines in these reports routinely carry several independently-aged clauses. Recommend the era_check emit BOTH the blame commit and an -S trace for the specific quoted numeral, and flag disagreement rather than silently taking blame.

Register a bound comparer. 077#13[0] ('>= 0.830') is UNRESOLVED as 'unparseable quote'; its marker-stripped twin 072#9[0] is a MISMATCH. Neither outcome is correct — the claim is satisfied. Until a bound comparer exists, correct extraction (preserving the marker per amendment 5) is punished with UNRESOLVED and incorrect extraction produces a false MISMATCH.

escalations.question: Does the partial-refresh residue class (R4) get its own disposition, or stay folded into SNAPSHOT-DIVERGENCE?
escalations.detail: Ruling 14's per-claim era test classifies these rows as era-faithful, which is correct on the evidence but produces a ledger-only outcome for what is, in four living paper-citation documents, a live internal contradiction (most sharply: corrected-f1-multi-buffer sections 10.2 vs 10.3, four lines apart, giving different precision and recall figures for the same buffer). Ruling 1 says living documents are corrected in place, which points at repair; ruling 14's disposition test points at ledger-only. I have applied ruling 14 and raised repairs separately, but the two rulings pull in different directions on this class and it is large enough (at least 6 clusters, 15+ rows in P2 alone) to want a settled answer before GATE 3.
